primitives.name: Format Composition
primitives.verbatim_quote: Recommended formats: - 30-60 second "how to use this page" - 5-12 second motion highlight - before/after example - captioned clip plus transcript - table walkthrough - founder-safe method boundary explainer
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'F_i': 'Format type index (dimensionless)', 'D_i': 'Duration of format i (seconds)', 'C_i': 'Comprehension gain from format i (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Each format type F_i contributes independently to overall comprehension C_i based on D_i.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Formats with D_i > 60 seconds show diminishing returns in comprehension gain.

layer2.mapping: Format composition defines a weighted sum kernel in GSE that optimizes cognitive load per format type during user interaction.
layer2.telemetry: Average comprehension score per format type across user sessions

primitives.name: Motion Explainer
primitives.verbatim_quote: use this page" - 5-12 second motion highlight - before/after example - captioned clip plus transcript
primitives.assumptions: Motion complexity M increases linearly with visual change between B and A; relevance R depends on alignment of M with user task.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When M exceeds perceptual threshold, R decreases due to cognitive overload.

Failure modes include overloading users with high-motion content or under-engaging them with low-duration formats. The kernel's robustness depends on adaptive modulation of format duration and complexity based on real-time user feedback.
